title: D(f) ∩ V(g_1,…,g_n) is the image of the immersion Spec((A/(g))_f) → Spec A
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f,g_1,\dots,g_n\in A$ ($n\ge0$), $J=(g_1,\dots,g_n)\subseteq A$, $\bar f$ the image of $f$ in $A/J$, and $B=(A/J)_{\bar f}$ the localization of $A/J$ at the powers of $\bar f$. Let $w:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be the morphism of affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum] induced by the composite ring map $A\to A/J\to B$. Then $w$ is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] (the open immersion $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/J)$ onto $D(\bar f)$ [def-weil-open-immersion] followed by the closed immersion $\operatorname{Spec}(A/J)\to\operatorname{Spec}A$), and its image is $w(\operatorname{Spec}B)=D(f)\cap V(g_1,\dots,g_n)=\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}A:f\notin\mathfrak p,\ g_1,\dots,g_n\in\mathfrak p\}$.
